name: code-dao-vendor
description: Solidity dependencies vendored via npm so the build needs no git submodules. The LayerZero and Stargate packages the interfaces in src/interfaces/ILayerZero.sol were transcribed from are deliberately NOT listed here: lz-evm-protocol-v2 2.0.11 requires @openzeppelin/contracts ^4.8.1 as a peer, this project compiles against 5.1.0, and npm refuses the tree. Nothing in those packages is compiled, so a reviewer who wants to diff installs them separately: npm install --no-save --legacy-peer-deps @layerzerolabs/lz-evm-protocol-v2@2.0.11 @layerzerolabs/lz-evm-oapp-v2@2.3.44 @stargatefinance/stg-evm-v2@9.0.0. The versions are also recorded in ILayerZero.sol itself.
